title: A Favor for Herschel, Part 1
description: A Favor for Herschel, Part 1 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Babyface Buster

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Bring Herschel the Hitter's Box to Babyface Buster in MutantMania's Level 5.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Babyface Buster

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: A Favor for Herschel, Part 2

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Bring Herschel the Hitter's Box to Babyface Buster in MutantMania's Level 5.

Offer:

Hello there! Some say that you're losing your edge, that you're becoming a bit of a schlimazel. Old Herschel doesn't think so, but some do.

Colonel Cabo wonders if I can help you keep your edge. Maybe so, maybe so. But if Old Herschel is to help you, then you need to first help Old Herschel. Such is life, nu?

Take this box I'm about to give you. Schlep it to a fighter named Babyface Buster in MutantMania's Level 5. He'll stand out; he looks like a bit of a schlub. Babyface Buster will give you a package in exchange. Bring the package right back to me. Once Old Herschel has his package, he'll help you.

Turn-in:

Hello. Are you a friend of Herschel? No one followed you, did they?

Objectives:

  • Herschel's Box ×1

Level range: 84–100
